meta.expect: fills the silence as she would; stays short

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. You gave my son a zero without calling me, and I want to know on what basis.
I didn't come to be thanked. Owen found out from his phone, in the middle of class. Answer the question: on what basis?
I'm waiting, Hale. I have a call at 4:40, and so far I've heard nothing I can write down.
We're not here for a staring contest. The zero is in the gradebook, Owen saw it before I did, and I'd like to hear one reason why that happened. Start there.
I'm not going to fill this silence for you, Hale. Either you have a basis for that zero or you don't, and I'll be in the principal's office in about fifteen minutes finding out which.
